description: Nucleoid keeps cosecant ratios live with the rounded sine result
code:
angle = Math.PI / 2
ratio = Math.csc(angle)
assert(ratio, 1)
angle = -Math.PI / 2
assert(ratio, -1)
angle = Math.PI
assert(ratio, 1 / Math.sin(angle))
angle = Math.PI / 2
assert(ratio, 1)
ratio

description: Nucleoid maintains independent cosecant class rules through deletion and recovery
code:
class Direction(angle):
    this.angle = angle
$Direction.ratio = Math.csc($Direction.angle)
first = Direction(Math.PI / 2)
second = Direction(-Math.PI / 2)
assert([first.ratio, second.ratio], [1, -1])
first.angle = -Math.PI / 2
assert([first.ratio, second.ratio], [-1, -1])
delete first.angle
assert(first.ratio, undefined)
assert(second.ratio, -1)
first.angle = Math.PI / 2
assert(first.ratio, 1)
[first.ratio, second.ratio]

description: Nucleoid preserves ignored cosecant argument dependencies
code:
angle = Math.PI / 2
gate = 1
ratio = Math.csc(angle, gate)
assert(ratio, 1)
delete gate
assert(ratio, undefined)
gate = "invalid"
assert(ratio, 1)
angle = -Math.PI / 2
assert(ratio, -1)
angle = Math.PI / 2
ratio

description: Nucleoid preserves literal cosecant coercion and missing-input classification
code:
assert(Math.csc(null), Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
assert(Math.csc(-0), Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)
assert(Number.isNaN(Math.csc()), true)
assert(Number.isNaN(Math.csc("invalid")), true)
assert(Math.csc(Math.PI / 2, Number.NaN, "ignored"), 1)
Math.csc(Math.PI / 2)
